answer: A lone agent rides a comet of cheap hashes; a swarm hits a nebula of rising cost, and any gale of fake accounts stalls at the same wall. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work identity binding: each agent must solve a computational puzzle whose difficulty scales with the number of identities it controls, forcing attackers to burn real compute per sock-puppet. Attackers pay linearly escalating energy while honest single identities pay once, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
